headline: Digital payments and local finance: how the pagoPA platform generates up to 469 million euros for Italian municipalities
summary: A study by PagoPA and the Italian State General Accounting Department found the digital payments platform generates up to €469 million for Italian municipalities, according to a PagoPA executive.
why: PagoPA is Italy's public digital payments platform, used by public administrations to collect payments from citizens and businesses.
